name: com.mtakemi.opencvsharp
description: OpenCvSharp (OpenCV 4.13.0 wrapper for .NET) for Unity. Supports Android arm64-v8a (IL2CPP) and the Windows x64 Editor.

samples.description: Runs basic checks (CvtColor, exceptions, codecs, ArUco + SolvePnP, QR, Texture2D <-> Mat) and shows the results on screen.
Detects ArUco markers (distance via SolvePnP) and QR codes in the WebCamTexture image and shows the result in a uGUI RawImage.
